training_protocol.message: CONVERGENCE: NORM OF PROJECTED GRADIENT <= PGTOL

note: These coefficients were fitted on the 5,000-event validation sample using the procedure documented in REPRODUCTION.md. The default runner loads this checkpoint so the paper reference run does not depend on small platform-specific optimizer differences. Use --refit-weights to rerun the optimizer and inspect the newly fitted coefficients; refitting can cause small numerical differences across platforms.
